integrity.mathematical_claim: joint Poisson point-process limit for early fixed-size and shape-resolved fringe subtree roots
integrity.method: exact beta-binomial one-root probabilities, conditional subtree-deletion factorization, joint factorial moments

scientific_limitations: Fixed finite subtree-size cutoff only; no growing-size or quantitative total-variation claim.

title: Independent Poisson colours for the oldest bounded fringe subtrees of a random recursive tree
